title: daVinci-Dev: Agent-native Mid-training for Software Engineering

layout.note: A recipe diagram at left in three columns (source pill and two ingredient cards, a cream panel holding two stacked trajectory tables, the Qwen2.5 and daVinci-Dev cards) and a titled bar chart at right.

lesson: When data come from one source in two ways, fan the source out into two colour-coded ingredient cards, give each a titled trajectory table and a one-line benefit caption, merge both into the model card, and end with a headline bar chart carrying a bold gain label.
